name: Chooita ~Subarashiki Chounouryoku Jinsei~
original_name: ちょ～イタ ～素晴らしき超能力人生～
source:
Tsutomu and Yuki met six months ago. To put it plainly, they're more than friends but less than lovers. All their dates have been group outings, and they've never gotten any closer than holding hands. They want to go further (purely out of curiosity, of course), but they just can't find the right opportunity.

One day, Tsutomu ends up in the hospital after hitting his head in a traffic accident. He wakes up to discover that he can suddenly see right through clothes. What's more, he can even read other people's minds! Basically, he's acquired X-ray vision and telepathy.

Reading Yuki's mind helps Tsutomu take their relationship from a hug to their first kiss. On top of that, he even manages to arrange a date with her—just the two of them.

Of course, their goal is to finally have sex. However, what should've been a piece of cake, given their mutual desire, turns into a chaotic adventure filled with all sorts of obstacles. A serial rape investigation, a fellow psychic, an unhinged exhibitionist, and a complete lack of common sense await...

[Adapted from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/choinfo.html]official website[/url] and [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/110/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
阿勉与由纪相识已有半年。说白了，两人目前正处于“友达以上，恋人未满”的微妙阶段——每次约会都是大家结伴同行，最亲密的举动也不过是牵牵小手。尽管两人都渴望更进一步（当然纯粹是出于好奇），却苦于一直找不到合适的契机。

某天，阿勉在一场车祸中撞伤了脑袋，被送进医院。一觉醒来，他竟发现自己的视线能够直接穿透衣物，甚至还能听见他人的心声！换句话说，他同时获得了透视眼与读心术两项超能力。

凭借偷听由纪的心声，阿勉顺利将两人的关系从拥抱推进到了初吻，甚至还成功约到了专属于两人的单独约会。

不用说，他们的终极目标自然是顺利滚上床单。然而两情相悦之下本该水到渠成的好事，却演变成了一场波折不断的荒诞大冒险——连环强奸案调查、同为超能力者的怪人、精神脱线的暴露狂，还有毫无常识可言的离奇闹剧正轮番等待着他们……

[改写并译自[url=https://www.liar.co.jp/choinfo.html]官方网站[/url]与[url=https://www.getchu.com/item/110/]Getchu[/url]]
